overview: The democratic legislature of the Galactic Republic, seated on Coruscant and led by the elected Supreme Chancellor.
history: Galactic Senate governed galactic affairs during the Galactic Republic. Detailed chronicles, succession rules, and institutional structure will be expanded in a future update.
significance: Galactic Senate shaped the political identity of its era and remains a reference point when historians compare later governments across the Star Wars timeline.
